equity_bridge.item: FVOCI equity instruments (cross-shareholdings) at fair value
equity_bridge.note: FY2025 yuho note 26 (25,033 level 1 + 10,450 level 3); their dividend income (~JPY1.3bn) is in finance income, outside the flows

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: FY2026 guidance (+6.9%) fading to JPY nominal growth; brackets the revenue 3yr (0.4%) and 5yr (7.8%) CAGRs
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 5.9% diverges >30% from revenue 3yr 0.4% and EPS 5yr 17.2%. All three are distorted: FY2020 base year was COVID-depressed (revenue 1,412bn, EPS 147), FY2022 EPS was -14 and FY2024 -444 on Life Science impairments, and ~JPY550bn of 'other components of equity' is yen-weakness translation, not retained earnings. None is a usable forward growth rate on its own.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series = reported FCF - interest income (SBC set to 0; the ~JPY0.5bn BIP-trust cost is immaterial) (FY2025 55.6bn; FY2020 28.2bn; FY2022 -14.8bn so the 3yr CAGR is undefined). Owner and reported FCF CAGRs are within 0.4pp because SBC is immaterial; the whole gap between the series is interest income. Revenue FY2015-2025 10yr CAGR 4.5%, flattered by yen depreciation (FX added JPY94bn to FY2024 sales alone).

scenario_narratives.base: AGC delivers its maintained FY2026 guidance (net sales JPY2,200bn, OP JPY150bn), then grinds OP margin from 6.8% toward ~8.3% by 2030 as the strategic businesses (EUV mask blanks and optoelectronic materials riding leading-edge semiconductor capex, performance fluorochemicals, the Thailand chlor-alkali expansion contributing from 2026, Life Science CDMO reaching breakeven around 2027) outgrow flat architectural glass and a commoditised display business. Capex intensity falls to ~1.0x D&A as management says, but working capital at 30% of revenue and a decade of sub-cost-of-capital ROE (4.7% in FY2025, 7% targeted) mean owner FCF stays at 3-4% of revenue. Revenue growth fades to 2% JPY nominal. Management's Vision 2030 (OP JPY300bn+, ROE 10%+) is not reached in this case; the once-cut AGC plus-2026 target is the pattern.
scenario_narratives.bull: The AI/leading-edge semiconductor cycle keeps EUV blank and electronic-materials demand compounding, performance chemicals capacity fills, Southeast Asian caustic soda/PVC pricing recovers from the Chinese oversupply trough, and the biopharma CDMO sites (Boulder, Copenhagen) finally hit the utilisation that justified the >JPY120bn of impairments. OP margin reaches ~10% (Vision 2030's JPY300bn delivered), Life Science losses stop leaking unsheltered tax, capex settles at ~1.05x D&A and the group finally earns above its cost of equity, which is what a re-rating from 0.77x book would require. Revenue grows 5-8% through 2029 on volume rather than yen weakness.
scenario_narratives.bear: H2 FY2026 misses (H1 EBITDA margin was 14.8% against a 15.7% full-year implied), then a 2027-28 downturn in European construction and global auto production coincides with yen appreciation as the BOJ normalises, removing the translation tailwind that drove FY2024-25 reported growth. Chinese float and automotive glass capacity (Xinyi, Fuyao) keeps architectural and auto pricing under pressure, caustic soda/PVC stays oversupplied, and the CDMO business disappoints again with further write-downs. Margins trough at 13.5% and recover only to the FY2023-25 band of ~15%; fixed yen-denominated D&A rises against a smaller revenue base; the medium-term targets are cut a second time. No solvency issue (D/E 0.4x, A-rated), but with net debt plus NCI claims of ~JPY815bn ahead of the equity, owner FCF of JPY40-60bn capitalised at 15x leaves little for shareholders: this scenario sits near the floor of the DCF and the share is worth its asset-liquidation optionality more than its cash flows.

valuation_philosophy.summary: AGC is a world-scale, asset-heavy, cyclical materials group whose reported EBITDA (~15-17% of revenue) converts to owner free cash flow at only 20-25% because capex has run 1.2-1.7x D&A for a decade and working capital absorbs ~15-30% of every yen of growth. The house owner-FCF DCF therefore values the equity well below a price that the market sets on book value and EV/EBITDA (0.77x book, ~6x trailing EBITDA). The 15x terminal cap binds in all three scenarios against a 7%/2% Gordon of 20.4x; even uncapped, the base case does not reach the current price. The gap to the market is the sum of (i) a terminal multiple of ~6x EBITDA that the market has always granted AGC's asset base, (ii) a margin recovery to Vision 2030 levels (the bull case), and (iii) faith that capex really does fall to ~1x D&A. House and street bases coincide (SBC-zero), so the valuation does not depend on SBC treatment at all; it depends on the capex/D&A ratio, the terminal cap and the NCI leakage. Entry prices at a 15% hurdle are far below intrinsic value, as expected for an asset discounted at 7%.
key_risks_to_valuation: Terminal cap: the 15x FCF cap (cyclical) implies a terminal EV/EBITDA of only ~3-4x against AGC's own 5-7x historical range; at AGC's historical ~6x EBITDA the base value would sit above the current price. The cap is the house's cyclical discipline, not a market forecast.
Capex/D&A: the base assumes ~1.0x ex-lease from 2027 on management's word; the 10-year history is 1.17-1.74x. Every 0.1x of capex/D&A is ~JPY18bn/yr of owner FCF, roughly JPY1,000/share at the cap.
NCI leakage modelled as 13% of post-tax profit in the flows; if NCI is instead deducted at book (JPY229bn) the base value is a few hundred yen lower in the bear and higher in the bull.
Yen: ~two-thirds of sales are outside Japan; FY2024-25 growth was largely translation. A stronger yen cuts reported revenue and the yen value of foreign-currency debt (EUR/USD/THB) alike.
Pension liability (JPY49.5bn) and FVOCI debt instruments (JPY7bn) are left out of the bridge; adding both would net roughly -JPY200/share.

The bear case sits near the DCF floor: with ~JPY586bn net debt ahead of the equity, a 15x multiple on JPY40-60bn of owner FCF leaves little equity value, which is a finding about financial structure and FCF conversion, not a solvency call.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API (query1.finance.yahoo.com, 5201.T) at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 4,765-8,315.
data_sources.financials: 5201.T_Metrics.csv (FY2014-H1 FY2026, millions JPY, IFRS); H1 FY2026 tanshin (balance sheet 2026-06-30, share count, FY2026 forecast); FY2025 yuho (income statement, cash-flow interest/tax lines, debt and lease notes, IFRS 2 note, note 26 financial instruments); FY2024 results presentation (AGC plus-2026 targets, capex/EBITDA outlook).
data_sources.qualitative: 5201.T_Analysis.json (2026-10-31): segment mix, moat, bull/bear cases, guidance table.

inputs.share_count_basis: 217,434,681 shares issued less 5,013,354 treasury shares at 2026-06-30 (H1 FY2026 tanshin). Potential dilution is immaterial: 18 legacy stock-option units x 200 shares and the BIP-trust shares (already inside treasury). FY2025 diluted weighted average was 212,371k. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows.
inputs.sbc_source: SBC-zero market, set to 0 by the house rule for non-US filers so house and street coincide. FY2025 yuho IFRS 2 note: equity-settled BIP (Board Incentive Plan) trust for directors and executive officers only; no stock options granted in FY2024 or FY2025. The IFRS 2 expense is not separately disclosed; ~JPY0.5bn is estimated from treasury-share deliveries to the trust (JPY405m H1 FY2025, JPY450m H1 FY2026). No cash equity-award taxes. SBC-zero market: house and street coincide.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 purchase of treasury shares JPY15m (odd-lot only); JPY50.0bn in FY2023 was the last real programme. The flat count is a convention the company is not currently funding; dilution from the BIP trust is ~0.02%/yr.
inputs.net_debt_note: H1 FY2026 tanshin: short-term interest-bearing debt 105,029 + current portion of long-term 153,750 + long-term 429,514->414,375 = 673,154 (AGC's own definition, INCLUDES lease liabilities of ~79,300 at FY2025: 14,960 current + 64,340 non-current); cash 87,570. Pension liability 49,462 and the JPY7,000m FVOCI debt instruments are not in the bridge.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in JPY, the currency of the flows. 10y JGB ~1.7% (Oct 2026), ERP 6.0%, beta ~1.15 (diversified cyclical) -> cost of equity ~8.6%. Pre-tax cost of debt ~2.3% (FY2025 interest paid 14,627 on ~650bn average interest-bearing debt, blended JPY/EUR/USD/THB), ~1.6% after tax. Market weights ~70% equity (incl. NCI) / 30% debt give ~6.5%; rounded UP to 7.0%. Below the ~9% house reference for small keiretsu suppliers because AGC is a JPY2tn-EV global #1-2 glass maker with A-rated debt and no customer concentration; the cyclicality and the Life Science execution risk are priced in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked on the discount rate. Same WACC in all three scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) Leases as debt. IFRS 16 lease liabilities (~JPY79.3bn) stay inside total_debt exactly as AGC reports its interest-bearing debt; lease principal is NOT deducted from the flows; lease interest (JPY1,761m) sits in finance costs below operating profit and is outside the flows; right-of-use depreciation stays inside the D&A path (tax EBIT is after full D&A). Ongoing lease-asset renewal is charged through capex_pct: +0.8pp of revenue in every scenario-year (lease payments due within one year JPY15.4bn = 0.75% of FY2025 revenue; new lease liabilities recognised 16.8bn FY2024 / 31.1bn FY2025).
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged ONCE, in the flows. Non-controlling interests (JPY228,865m book at 2026-06-30, 13.0% of FY2025 net income, 14.2% of H1 FY2026) are folded into cash_tax_rate_path as a combined tax + NCI leakage: leakage = 1 - (1 - tax)(1 - 0.13). The NCI stock is deliberately NOT deducted in the equity bridge, so the charge scales with each scenario (NCI sits mostly in the cyclical Thai chlor-alkali subsidiaries) rather than being a fixed JPY1,077/share. Calibration: FY2025 EBIT 127,465 x (1-0.33) x (1-0.13) = 74.3bn vs attributable net income 69,162 + after-tax net finance cost ~4.0bn = 73.2bn; ties within 1.5%. Deducting NCI at book instead would be ~JPY200-250m lower in the bridge but would then require removing the 13% leakage from the flows.
inputs.matching_assets_note: AGC's operating profit excludes finance income (interest 9,315 + FVOCI dividends ~1,343 in FY2025) so the flows already exclude the income on cash and on the equity portfolio; cash is in net debt and the FVOCI equity instruments (JPY35,484m fair value, FY2025 yuho note 26) are added in the bridge. Equity-method profit (JPY1,997m) is ABOVE operating profit in AGC's P&L and therefore inside the flows, so equity-method investments (JPY41,734m) are NOT added. Reported FCF is a levered figure: interest paid (14,627) and interest/dividends received (10,196) both sit inside AGC's operating cash flow; last_fcf strips the income side; the forward build starts from EBITDA so neither affects projected FCF.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md row 'operating company, non-US or cyclical: industrials'), scenario-weighted, 10-year explicit horizon because the base margin is still ramping through year 5. Reasons: AGC is a diversified, capital-intensive, cyclical manufacturer (glass, automotive glass, display/semiconductor materials, chlor-alkali/fluorochemicals, CDMO) reporting IFRS in JPY; not a bank, REIT, LIC or holdco. First valuation of this ticker; no memory entry. Adaptations applied: JPY-built WACC; one lease treatment (A); NCI charged once via the leakage rate; matching-asset rule for finance income vs cash + FVOCI equities; SBC-zero market (explicit 0.02% SBC row kept, band_position collapses). FY0 is FY2025 (Dec year-end); year 1 is FY2026 on management's maintained guidance (net sales 2,200bn, OP 150bn, attributable NI 77bn). FCF conversion is the whole story: capex has run 1.17-1.74x D&A for a decade and working capital is ~30% of revenue, so owner FCF is only 2-4% of revenue even at mid-cycle margins; the terminal cap (15x FCF, cyclical) binds in every scenario against a 7%/2% Gordon of 20.4x. A cap at AGC's own historical EV/EBITDA (~6x) would put the base value above the current price; the gap between that memo and the house value is the price of assuming the market keeps paying asset-value multiples for sub-cost-of-capital returns.

bear.narrative_note: FY2026 guidance missed on H2 (H1 run-rate 14.8% EBITDA), a 2027-28 auto/construction downturn with yen appreciation (revenue -1%/-2%), trough 13.5% then recovery only to the FY2023-25 level of 15.0%; D&A fixed in yen rises as a % of a smaller revenue base; capex cut to maintenance (1.0x D&A ex-lease); cash tax 35-36% because Life Science losses continue unsheltered. Terminal growth 1% (Japan-weighted nominal).

base.growth_note: FY2026 at the maintained guidance (+6.9%, H1 was +10.6% with a yen tailwind); then 3.5%/3.0% as Thailand chlor-alkali capacity, EUV blanks and performance chemicals grow against flat architectural glass; fading to 2% JPY nominal growth.
base.margin_note: FY2026 15.6% = guided OP 150bn + ~195bn D&A on 2,200bn, shaded slightly for an H1 run-rate of 14.8%. Ramps to 17.0% by 2030 (OP margin ~8.3%, ~JPY205bn) as Life Science CDMO reaches breakeven and strategic businesses pass 56% of OP. That is the 10-year EBITDA average (16.5%) plus a little, and well short of Vision 2030's JPY300bn+ OP.
base.capex_note: Includes +0.8pp/yr for lease-asset renewal (treatment A). Ex-lease capex 9.3% -> 8.9% of revenue vs D&A 8.9% -> 8.7%: a capex/D&A ratio of ~1.02x, which is generous against the 1.17-1.74x of the last decade and relies on management's 'peak investment completed 2025, cash generation from 2026' statement (H1 FY2026 capex annualises at ~9.3%).
base.tax_note: Combined cash tax + NCI leakage. Cash tax 33% (FY2025 cash taxes 41.8bn / EBIT 127.5bn = 32.8%; book rate 36.3% inflated by unsheltered Life Science losses) easing to 31% as those losses roll off; NCI 13% of post-tax profit throughout. 1-(0.67)(0.87)=41.7%; 1-(0.69)(0.87)=40.0%.
base.wc_note: Receivables 343 + inventories 496 - payables 212 = JPY627bn = 30% of revenue; growth consumes cash. -15% capture on the revenue change rather than the full 30% because part of each year's growth is FX translation (FY2022: ~-21% observed on +338bn of revenue).

bull.narrative_note: Margin reaches 18.5% EBITDA (OP ~10%, ~JPY280-300bn by 2030 = Vision 2030 delivered); tax leakage eases to 30% cash tax as Life Science turns profitable and shelters its own losses; capex settles at ~1.05x D&A ex-lease.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25%: the medium-term OP target has already been cut once (JPY230bn -> 180bn in Feb 2025) and the actual FY2026 guidance is JPY150bn, Life Science has a multi-site record of impairments, and two of the four core businesses are in Chinese-oversupplied commodities; no going-concern risk, so not higher. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs three independent things at once (CDMO utilisation, chlor-alkali price recovery, and the semiconductor cycle staying hot) plus a re-rating the market has refused for a decade. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
